about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A curious mind in a digital world
about.p1: Hi! I'm Valenisaa, an Informatics Engineering graduate who loves exploring technology and learning new things. My journey started with web development, but along the way I discovered a strong interest in artificial intelligence, data, and how technology can be used to solve real problems.
about.p2: I enjoy building projects from scratch and learning through hands-on experience. For me, every project is a chance to improve not just technically, but also in the way I think and solve problems.
about.p3: These days, I'm focusing on data engineering while continuing to expand my skills in SQL, Python, and modern data tools. I'm always excited to learn, build, and take on new challenges.

1.title: Frontend Developer Intern
1.description: Developed responsive web interfaces using React and Bootstrap while collaborating with backend developers to deliver scalable and user-friendly applications.

2.title: Certified Independent Study (MBKM)
2.description: Completed an industry-oriented Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning program through hands-on projects involving classification, clustering, and predictive model development.

3.title: AI-Based Child Growth Monitoring — Contributor
3.description: Assisted in developing an AI-based child growth monitoring system for stunting prevention using Machine Learning algorithms, resulting in an officially copyrighted software project.

4.title: IoT Automatic Smoking System — Contributor
4.description: Contributed to the development and technical documentation of an IoT-based automatic smoking system that was officially registered for Indonesian software copyright.

5.title: Drafter — Technical Drawing Projects
5.description: Produced technical drawings and engineering drafts for various academic and small-scale freelance projects, developing strong attention to detail.
